🚨 Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) Alert! 🚨

Recent reports indicate a surge in HMPV cases, particularly among children under 14 in northern China. 

🦠 What is HMPV? A respiratory virus causing symptoms like fever, cough, nasal congestion, and shortness of breath.
